generated.details: Behind the table in the middle-left plane, a woven oatmeal rug lies flat on the wood floor, its interlaced fibers ending in a softly bound perimeter.

On its visible portion, a partially assembled abstract-color puzzle consists of flat cardboard pieces joined by tabs and sockets, with irregular unfinished edges and a few loose pieces alongside; no text or faces.
At the far-left window, relaxed ivory linen curtains hang from a rod in loose vertical folds, with stitched hems and softly translucent fabric.
